description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the evaluated PPL (Perplexity) and the normalized parameters ratio (%) for four different models: Transformer, Only MoHD FFN, Only MoHD ATTN, and MoHD ATTN + MLP. The x-axis, labeled "Normalized Parameters Ratio (%)", spans from 100 to 25, with tick marks at 100, 75, 50, and 25, representing a logarithmic scale. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", ranges from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The Transformer model is represented by a red dashed line, which shows a steady increase in PPL from approximately 11.7 at 100% to 13.5 at 25%. The "Only MoHD FFN" model is shown with a gray dashed line, starting at around 11.7 and increasing to about 12.5. The "Only MoHD ATTN" model, depicted by a dark blue solid line, begins at approximately 11.7 and rises to about 13.2. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" model, represented by a bright blue solid line, starts at around 11.7 and increases sharply to approximately 14.0 at 25%. All models exhibit an increasing trend in PPL as the normalized parameters ratio decreases, with the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" model showing the most significant increase.
